# Fanfarr v0.5.36

Fanfarr finds theme music for a Plex library, writes it beside the media as a
local `theme.mp3`, and keeps a permanent record of what it did and why.

## Type that stays readable

The condensed display face retreats to large numerals only -- attention
counts, coverage percentages -- after reading worse than the system sans at
table and heading sizes. Recorded as a constraint: condensed at text size
costs the scan speed the whole page exists for.

## Upgrading

Pull the new image and restart; the database migrates itself on boot.
